name: Big Brother
description: Portuguese version of the reality competition which follows a group of HouseGuests living together 24 hours a day in the "Big Brother" house, isolated from the outside world but under constant surveillance with no privacy.

videos.title: Gala 1
videos.overview: A group of people live in a house under survaillence 24/7, isolated from the outside world and trying to avoid being voted out by the public with the aim of winning a big cash prize at the end of the run.

videos.title: BB ZOOM: Gala 1 (Premiere)
videos.overview: 20 years later, the doors of the most watched house in the country reopen.
